description:
@ICICILombard  ICICILombard ne hume “Unscrupulous” bola ❤️‍🩹 but 40 din pehle humne hi unhe warn kiya tha!
Full proof, emails & truth about the Material Change Clause 🔍
Watch till the end — ye video insurance industry ke liye ek eye-opener hai 💥

almost 40 din pehle humne hi Beshak Team ko ICICI ke “Material Change Clause” ke baare mein bataya tha — tab unhe bhi is clause ka awareness nahi tha.

Aaj jab humne sach samjhaane ki koshish ki, kuch logon ne hum par hi sawaal utha diye 💔
Iss 20-minute ke detailed video mein humne:
🔹 ICICI Lombard ke official clarification aur statement ka full analysis kiya hai
🔹 March 2025 mein bheje gaye apne official clarification email (proof) dikhaye hain
🔹 Clause ke real meaning ko policy wording ke base pe samjhaya hai
🔹 Aur apna dukh bhi share kiya hai — kyunki ek responsible content creator hone ke bawajood, hume “unscrupulous” kehna sahi nahi tha
Phir bhi, hum ICICI Lombard ko high regard mein rakhte hain 🙏
Ye company industry ke leaders mein se hai, jinhone ethical standards aur trust build kiya hai.✅

Humne video mein unki tarif bhi ki hai, kyunki humara maksad clarity aur transparency lana hai, na ki conflict.🙏🏻

Full clarification + proof emails shown in video!
Respect for @ICICILombard but truth must be clear.🙏
We also Deserve respectful words.

📧 For personal consultancy: amazingdhiraj07@outlook.com
#TransparencyMatters #ICICILombard #InsuranceAwareness

Disclaimer - This video and its contents are created solely for educational, informational, and awareness purposes.The intent is not to defame, harm, or misrepresent ICICI Lombard or any individual/organization. 
All statements are based on personal opinions, factual documents, official communications, and publicly available information.We fully respect @ICICILombard contribution to the Indian insurance industry and acknowledge their ethical business practices.
Viewers are advised to verify all information and consult a qualified financial advisor or legal expert before taking any decision.
The creator and this channel shall not be liable for any interpretations, actions, or consequences arising from this content.

While ICICI Lombard has clarified that your premium or coverage will not be altered at renewal simply because you develop a new illness after policy issuance.

That said, the clause itself still creates ambiguity and you’re absolutely justified in questioning the use of the term “unscrupulous” and the broader grievance-handling culture.

Thanks again for sharing your perspective. It adds crucial value to this discussion.🫡

The policy is based on the statements and declarations made in the proposal form, and non-disclosure or misrepresentation of material facts can render the policy voidable at the insurer's discretion. 💫

Which is acceptable.
